sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99% Invisible》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: On January 7th, 1998, an envelope landed on the desk of Larry Calloway.
sentences.zh: 1998年1月7日，一个信封被送到了拉里·卡洛韦的办公桌上。

sentences.en: He was a columnist with the Albuquerque Journal.
sentences.zh: 他是《阿尔伯克基日报》的一名专栏作家。

sentences.en: It was sort of a combination of a press release and a ransom note, and a photo.
sentences.zh: 那封信看起来像是新闻稿、勒索信和一张照片的结合体。

sentences.en: The photo was a Polaroid of a cut-off riding boot with a huge Spanish spur, all in bronze.
sentences.zh: 照片是一张宝丽来快照，拍的是一只被切断的马靴，靴子上带着巨大的西班牙式马刺，通体青铜材质。

sentences.en: And I read the note.
sentences.zh: 我读了那封信。

sentences.en: The note hinted that the bronze foot came from a statue of a man named Juan de Oñate,
sentences.zh: 信中暗示，这只青铜脚来自一座名为胡安·德·奥尼亚特的雕像，

sentences.en: seated on a horse.
sentences.zh: 雕像中的他正骑在马上。

sentences.en: It was part of a monument on the side of a rural highway
sentences.zh: 那是乡村公路旁一座纪念碑的一部分，

sentences.en: near where Oñate founded the first Spanish colony in New Mexico, back in 1598.
sentences.zh: 就在奥尼亚特于1598年建立新墨西哥州第一个西班牙殖民地的地方附近。

sentences.en: Larry figured this was probably a hoax.
sentences.zh: 拉里觉得这很可能是一个恶作剧。

sentences.en: This is Stan Alcorn, a reporter with the investigative podcast Reveal.
sentences.zh: 我是斯坦·奥尔康，调查类播客《Reveal》的一名记者。

sentences.en: There are collaborators on the story today.
sentences.zh: 今天这个故事有几位合作者。

sentences.en: So he handed the tip off to the newsroom, and a reporter called up the visitor center at the Oñate Monument.
sentences.zh: 于是他把这条线索转交给了新闻编辑部，一位记者打电话给奥尼亚特纪念碑的游客中心。

sentences.en: And asked, is your statue missing a right foot?
sentences.zh: 问他们：你们的雕像是不是少了一只右脚？

sentences.en: And the guy said, what?
sentences.zh: 那个人说：什么？

sentences.en: And he went out and checked, came back, and he was, you know, in shock.
sentences.zh: 他出去检查了一下，回来时，你知道，他惊呆了。

sentences.en: He said it's gone.
sentences.zh: 他说脚不见了。

sentences.en: Oñate is one of the world's lesser-known conquistadors, but his name is all over New Mexico.
sentences.zh: 奥尼亚特是世界上知名度较低的征服者之一，但他的名字在新墨西哥州随处可见。

sentences.en: There are Oñate streets, Oñate schools.
sentences.zh: 有奥尼亚特街，奥尼亚特学校。

sentences.en: For decades, there was an annual fiesta where one lucky guy would get to be Oñate,
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这里每年都会举办节日庆典，一个幸运儿会被选为奥尼亚特的扮演者，

sentences.en: complete with a cape and helmet.
sentences.zh: 还要穿上斗篷、戴上头盔。

sentences.en: There's even a song.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一首歌。

sentences.en: In parts of New Mexico, he's treated as a kind of founding father.
sentences.zh: 在新墨西哥州的部分地区，他被视为某种开国元勋。

sentences.en: But history is not all song and dance and wearing capes.
sentences.zh: 但历史并非全是歌舞和穿斗篷那么简单。

sentences.en: He was a conquistador, after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他是一位征服者。

sentences.en: The envelope Larry got also included an excerpt from a history book
sentences.zh: 拉里收到的信封里还附有一本历史书的摘录，

sentences.en: on Oñate's treatment of New Mexico's native people.
sentences.zh: 内容是关于奥尼亚特如何对待新墨西哥州的原住民。

sentences.en: It described an incident that ended with Oñate
sentences.zh: 书中描述了一起事件，最终奥尼亚特

sentences.en: sentencing a group of men from Acoma Pueblo
sentences.zh: 判处阿科马普韦布洛的一群男子，

sentences.en: to each have one foot chopped off.
sentences.zh: 每人被砍掉一只脚。

sentences.en: If the symbolism of removing the statue's foot was unclear,
sentences.zh: 如果说砍掉雕像脚的象征意义还不明确的话，

sentences.en: the note made it explicit.
sentences.zh: 那封信把它说得明明白白。

sentences.en: It said, we took the liberty of removing Oñate's right foot
sentences.zh: 信上说：我们擅自取下了奥尼亚特的右脚，

sentences.en: on behalf of our brothers and sisters at Acoma Pueblo.
sentences.zh: 代表我们在阿科马普韦布洛的兄弟姐妹们。

sentences.en: We will be melting this foot down and casting small medallions to be sold to those who are historically ignorant.
sentences.zh: 我们将熔化这只脚，铸成小奖章，卖给那些历史盲。

sentences.en: The statue's sculptor cast a new right foot and reattached it.
sentences.zh: 雕像的雕塑家铸造了一只新的右脚并重新装了上去。

sentences.en: The medallions never turned up, but the story stuck.
sentences.zh: 奖章从未出现过，但这个故事却流传了下来。

sentences.en: It got picked up by NPR and the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 它被美国国家公共电台（NPR）和《纽约时报》报道了。

sentences.en: I was a seventh grader in Albuquerque at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时我还是阿尔伯克基的一名七年级学生。

sentences.en: And what I remember is how the subject I found most boring, history,
sentences.zh: 我记得最清楚的是，我曾经觉得最无聊的学科——历史，

sentences.en: was suddenly this exciting mystery that remains unsolved to this day.
sentences.zh: 突然变成了一个至今未解的悬疑谜题。

sentences.en: Who stole Oneate's foot?
sentences.zh: 到底是谁偷了奥尼亚特的脚？

sentences.en: And then there was the timing.
sentences.zh: 而且还有时间点的问题。

sentences.en: 1998 was the 400th anniversary of Oneate's arrival.
sentences.zh: 1998年是奥尼亚特抵达400周年。

sentences.en: There were cortocentenario celebrations planned all over the state.
sentences.zh: 全州各地都计划举行四百周年纪念活动。

sentences.en: There would be theater, parades, a commemorative stamp.
sentences.zh: 会有戏剧、游行和纪念邮票。

sentences.en: In a second note to the paper, the so-called Friends of Acoma wrote,
sentences.zh: 在给报社的第二封信中，所谓的“阿科马之友”写道：

sentences.en: We see no glory in celebrating Oñate's fourth centennial, and we do not want our faces rubbed in it.
sentences.zh: 我们认为庆祝奥尼亚特四百周年毫无荣耀可言，我们也不想被强行灌输这种观念。

sentences.en: In other words, the point of cutting off the statue's foot was to spoil the party.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，砍掉雕像脚的目的就是为了搅局。

sentences.en: And the centerpiece of that party that got a mention in all the foot-cutting stories
sentences.zh: 而在所有关于砍脚报道中提到的那场庆典的核心，

sentences.en: was a cuarto centenario memorial being planned for Albuquerque's historic center.
sentences.zh: 是计划在阿尔伯克基历史中心建造的一座四百周年纪念碑。

sentences.en: The proposal?
sentences.zh: 提案是什么？

sentences.en: Another bronze statue of Juan de Oñate.
sentences.zh: 另一座胡安·德·奥尼亚特的青铜雕像。

sentences.en: This one right in the middle of New Mexico's biggest city.
sentences.zh: 就立在新墨西哥州最大城市的中心地带。

sentences.en: But with all this new attention on Oñate,
sentences.zh: 但随着奥尼亚特受到如此多的新关注，

sentences.en: the second statue wasn't going to get built without a fight.
sentences.zh: 第二座雕像如果不经过一番抗争是建不成的。

sentences.en: I still didn't see the storm that was coming.
sentences.zh: 我当时还没看出即将到来的风暴。

sentences.en: It was still in its infancy.
sentences.zh: 它还处于萌芽阶段。

sentences.en: Conchita Lucero was one of the organizers of the 400th anniversary celebrations in Albuquerque
sentences.zh: 康奇塔·卢塞罗是阿尔伯克基400周年纪念活动的组织者之一，

sentences.en: and one of the most passionate advocates for a new Oñate statue.
sentences.zh: 也是新奥尼亚特雕像最热情的倡导者之一。

sentences.en: A passion that goes back to her childhood, growing up in 1950s New Mexico, knowing almost nothing about Oñate, or the state's two centuries as a Spanish colony.
sentences.zh: 这种热情源于她的童年，她在20世纪50年代的新墨西哥州长大，几乎对奥尼亚特或该州作为西班牙殖民地的两个世纪历史一无所知。

sentences.en: When I was a child, at 10 years of age, I asked my grandmother, who was a school teacher, I was reading the American history books, I said, didn't our people do anything?
sentences.zh: 当我还是个10岁的孩子时，我问身为教师的祖母，当时我正在读美国历史书，我说：我们的人民难道什么都没做吗？

sentences.en: You know, that's how I felt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: She didn't know New Mexico history.
sentences.zh: 她也不了解新墨西哥州的历史。

sentences.en: All Conchita knew was that her Spanish ancestors had come to the state centuries before the Anglo classmates who called people like her dirty Mexicans,
sentences.zh: 康奇塔只知道她的西班牙祖先比那些称她为“肮脏墨西哥人”的盎格鲁同学早几个世纪来到这个州，

sentences.en: or the Anglo teachers who kept her out of a leadership club.
sentences.zh: 也比那些把她拒之于领导力俱乐部之外的盎格鲁老师早得多。

sentences.en: And she knew that racism and ignorance of history were somehow connected.
sentences.zh: 她明白种族主义和历史无知在某种程度上是相互关联的。

sentences.en: If we make you feel like the underdog, and then we take away your history and take away your knowledge, you're starting from scratch.
sentences.zh: 如果我们让你觉得自己是弱者，然后剥夺你的历史和知识，你就等于从零开始。

sentences.en: conversations.
sentences.zh: 对话。

sentences.en: You don't know how to even participate.
sentences.zh: 你甚至不知道该如何参与。

sentences.en: You just let the other guy put you
sentences.zh: 你只能任由别人把你

sentences.en: down.
sentences.zh: 看扁。

sentences.en: Conchita thought if she could just search out her own European roots, it would help her fight
sentences.zh: 康奇塔认为，如果她能去探寻自己的欧洲血统，这将有助于她进行抗争。

sentences.en: back.
sentences.zh: 回溯。

sentences.en: None of this is uncommon in New Mexico, where people have been reaching back to their
sentences.zh: 在新墨西哥州，这一切并不罕见，人们自19世纪以来就一直在追溯他们的

sentences.en: colonial roots and identifying as Spanish since the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 殖民根源，并以西班牙裔自居。

sentences.en: After Conchita retired, she found a
sentences.zh: 康奇塔退休后，在当地的家谱和历史协会里

sentences.en: lot of like minds in local genealogical and historical societies.
sentences.zh: 找到了许多志同道合的人。

sentences.en: She learned how to use
sentences.zh: 她学会了如何利用

sentences.en: birth and death and baptism records to trace her family tree.
sentences.zh: 出生、死亡和洗礼记录来追溯她的家族树。

sentences.en: There was the occasional Native
sentences.zh: 虽然偶尔也会发现有美洲原住民

sentences.en: American ancestor, but she was most excited to find branches like the one that extended back to
sentences.zh: 祖先，但她最兴奋的是发现了像这样的一支，可以追溯到

sentences.en: a Spanish captain who brought his wife and kids through the Chihuahuan desert on Oneate's 1598
sentences.zh: 一位西班牙船长，他在1598年奥尼亚特（Oñate）的远征中

sentences.en: expedition.
sentences.zh: 带着妻子和孩子穿过了奇瓦瓦沙漠。

sentences.en: She saw them as having transformed the region by bringing livestock and Catholicism
sentences.zh: 她认为他们通过带来牲畜、天主教

sentences.en: and the Spanish language.
sentences.zh: 和西班牙语，改变了这个地区。

sentences.en: You'd start finding your family members and you were going,
sentences.zh: 当你开始找到你的家族成员时，你会感叹，

sentences.en: wow, I never knew they did all of this.
sentences.zh: 哇，我从不知道他们做了这么多事。

sentences.en: Did it change how you saw yourself?
sentences.zh: 这改变了你看待自己的方式吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I never argued that one person wasn't as good as the other,
sentences.zh: 我从未争辩过某个人不如另一个人好，

sentences.en: but sometimes you were made to feel inferior.
sentences.zh: 但有时你会被人弄得觉得自己低人一等。

sentences.en: And at that point, that inferiority left.
sentences.zh: 而那一刻，那种自卑感消失了。

sentences.en: And so it was that Conchita was on the Cuarto Centenario committee
sentences.zh: 因此，当康奇塔在“四百年纪念”委员会任职时，

sentences.en: when they met with the Albuquerque Arts Board
sentences.zh: 他们与阿尔伯克基艺术委员会会面，

sentences.en: to discuss their request for a prominent new statue of Juan de Oñate,
sentences.zh: 讨论他们关于为胡安·德·奥尼亚特（Juan de Oñate）立一座显眼新雕像的请求，

sentences.en: the man they called the father of the Hispanic culture and our state.
sentences.zh: 那个被他们称为西班牙文化和我们州之父的人。

sentences.en: And who the Friends of Acoma accused of destroying Native people's way of life.
sentences.zh: 而阿科马之友（Friends of Acoma）则指责他摧毁了原住民的生活方式。

sentences.en: Was what happened at Acoma brought up?
sentences.zh: 阿科马发生的事情被提出来了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: And was it on your mind?
sentences.zh: 你当时有想到这件事吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Was it something that you knew about?
sentences.zh: 这是你了解的事情吗？

sentences.en: I wasn't as versed in it as I have become.
sentences.zh: 我当时对它的了解不如现在这么深入。

sentences.en: For people who don't know Acoma, what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 对于那些不了解阿科马的人，那意味着什么？

sentences.en: This is Alida, or Tweedy Soazo, an Acoma woman who would become an outspoken opponent of an
sentences.zh: 这是阿丽达，或者叫特威迪·索阿佐（Tweedy Soazo），一位阿科马女性，后来成为了

sentences.en: Oñate statue in Albuquerque.
sentences.zh: 阿尔伯克基奥尼亚特雕像的直言不讳的反对者。

sentences.en: Acoma is the oldest continuously inhabited community in the United States.
sentences.zh: 阿科马是美国最古老的持续有人居住的社区。

sentences.en: And it sits on a mesa 375 feet above the valley below.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在一座高出下方山谷375英尺的平顶山上。

sentences.en: She actually carries a postcard of Acoma to show people when she travels.
sentences.zh: 她旅行时甚至会随身带着一张阿科马的明信片展示给别人看。

sentences.en: It's a village built on top of a mesa, which if you're not from the desert, is like a huge rock pedestal.
sentences.zh: 那是一个建在平顶山上的村庄，如果你不是来自沙漠地区，那就像是一个巨大的岩石基座。

sentences.en: And that mesa just towers over the flat, empty plain below.
sentences.zh: 那座平顶山高高耸立在下方平坦、空旷的平原之上。

sentences.en: All of it a hundred shades of brown, from light tan to deep ruSt. It's incredible.
sentences.zh: 整个地方呈现出一百种棕色，从浅棕色到深锈色。真是不可思议。

sentences.en: The tough thing with radios, you don't have pictures.
sentences.zh: 广播最难的地方在于，你没有画面。

sentences.en: How do you help people visualize it?
sentences.zh: 你如何帮助人们想象它呢？

sentences.en: Because it's like no other place on Earth.
sentences.zh: 因为它和地球上任何其他地方都不一样。

sentences.en: No, it's not.
sentences.zh: 不，确实不一样。

sentences.en: It's beautiful.
sentences.zh: 它很美。

sentences.en: It's desert and rocks and sandstone, and that's where I come from, you know.
sentences.zh: 那是沙漠、岩石和砂岩，那就是我来自的地方，你知道的。

sentences.en: And unlike the dozens of pueblos that disappeared after the arrival of the Spanish, Acoma is still here.
sentences.zh: 与西班牙人到来后消失的几十个普韦布洛村落不同，阿科马依然存在。

sentences.en: Each year, tens of thousands of tourists drive an hour west of Albuquerque
sentences.zh: 每年，成千上万的游客驱车前往阿尔伯克基以西一小时的路程，

sentences.en: and then take a tour bus up a steep road to the top of the mesa.
sentences.zh: 然后乘坐旅游巴士沿着陡峭的道路登上平顶山顶。

sentences.en: So just watch yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以请注意安全。

sentences.en: Don't get too close to the edge.
sentences.zh: 不要离边缘太近。

sentences.en: If you happen to fall over the edge, this is the end of your tour,
sentences.zh: 如果你不小心掉下悬崖，你的旅程就结束了，

sentences.en: and no refunds will be given, so just keep that in mind.
sentences.zh: 而且不予退款，所以请记住这一点。

sentences.en: On top, you can see buildings made of mud and sandstone
sentences.zh: 在山顶，你可以看到用泥土和砂岩建造的建筑，

sentences.en: that tour guides say date back to the 1100s.
sentences.zh: 导游说这些建筑可以追溯到1100年代。

sentences.en: If you think about it, these houses have been passed down through the same family
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，这些房子在同一个家族中代代相传，

sentences.en: for almost 1,000 years now.
sentences.zh: 至今已有近1000年的历史了。

sentences.en: So now we're going to be walking past some of the older houses right up here, folks.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，现在我们要走过一些更古老的房子了。

sentences.en: All along the tour, there are tables where Acoma artists sell their wares,
sentences.zh: 在整个游览过程中，到处都有桌子，阿科马的艺术家们在那里出售他们的手工艺品，

sentences.en: mostly pottery.
sentences.zh: 主要是陶器。

sentences.en: These costs are made from the area here, about two miles.
sentences.zh: 这些材料都是就地取材的，大约两英里范围内。

sentences.en: But it's not just a tourist attraction.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是一个旅游景点。

sentences.en: There are 15 families that live up top year-round,
sentences.zh: 有15个家庭常年住在山顶上，

sentences.en: and hundreds more like Tweety's, who go there for special occasions.
sentences.zh: 还有数百个像特威迪家那样的人，会在特殊场合回到那里。

sentences.en: Funerals, deaths, religious fiestas, we were always there.
sentences.zh: 葬礼、祭祀、宗教节日，我们总是在那里。

sentences.en: What did you know about the history of your people in that place?
sentences.zh: 关于你族人在那个地方的历史，你知道些什么？

sentences.en: that we came from the underworld
sentences.zh: 我们来自地下世界，

sentences.en: on the back of Grandmother Spider.
sentences.zh: 骑在蜘蛛奶奶的背上。

sentences.en: We wandered the earth,
sentences.zh: 我们在大地上流浪，

sentences.en: and when we got to where Acoma was,
sentences.zh: 当我们到达阿科马所在的地方时，

sentences.en: we were told this is where we're supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知这就是我们应该待的地方。

sentences.en: That's what I knew, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就是我知道的，你知道的，

sentences.en: that we've been there forever.
sentences.zh: 我们一直都在那里。

sentences.en: Tweedy also knew that when the Spanish arrived,
sentences.zh: 特威迪也知道，当西班牙人到达时，

sentences.en: they did terrible things to her ancestors.
sentences.zh: 他们对她的祖先做了可怕的事情。

sentences.en: But she didn't know the details.
sentences.zh: 但她并不了解细节。

sentences.en: Historians know many of those details today
